name: deferred-profile-boundary
goal: Initialization observations never stand in for deferred object operations; retain real data initialization profiles.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Importing a registered object with a method, nested arrow or Map-held callback emits a successful initialization profile without invoking its deferred work. Keep genuine Map/data initialization eligible and reject import-only callable evidence.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing source-profile runner data case covers only a Map of numbers, failed initialization and types. Extend that same standard matrix with nested plain data, methods, nested arrows, Map callbacks, getters and nested classes. Assert scope observations only for actual data initialization; do not call deferred work in the import-only cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 7226b67bd strengthened the same standard matrix before repair. Immutable Harness red proof records 7 import-only cases incorrectly producing 2 observations instead of 0, while genuine data and existing runner cases pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Traverse executable callable bodies at every initializer depth; accept only recursively inspected literal object/array/known-container data. Unknown callback references must keep profiling incomplete. Preserve model/schema initialization scope and normal function invocation observers.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Recursive source inspection rejects nested callable bodies and opaque values inside literal data and known containers. Function invocation instrumentation and genuine data/schema initialization remain intact.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At 5bcab4186 immutable green da5c5210 pairs with test-only red 965b1009 at 5a9cbc2ee: all 14 unchanged runner cases pass after 7 deferred cases fail. The earlier 7226b67bd/643b3cf25 pair remains retained. Matrix lint, root types and audit pass; 26 runner/lifecycle/sampling cases passed.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Fresh recurrence ran actual broken source 5a9cbc2ee in an isolated snapshot: red 7f0b104f fails all 7 deferred cases. Restored fixed 5bcab4186: green 49e19571 passes all 14 unchanged cases in the same environment. Inputs and original outputs are retained in Harness evidence.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
